migration_phrases.phrase: Stage and fsync the complete public release/image/checksums/config/allocations.
Drain each sorted adapter; pre-start stop; stop the scoped old service; post-stop stop; verify **all** identity users stopped.
Require stopped-state retention metadata, exact old release checksum, original state format and same nodeID/IP/approval/server facts.
Restore/verify same public identity/IP/approvals/exact server, then rename that existing node, never recreate it.
Require fixture mode/isolation/client check; scoped service start; sorted adapter rebind/post-start start/health check; durably commit the fixture result.
Write to an exclusively created mode0600 pending file in bounded4096-byte writes; verify the still-named private file; file fsync; publish by atomic rename; fsync parent.
Existing journals are checksum/content CAS checked before replacement.
Partial pending writes are removed only on explicit resume/rollback under the same lock
Known partial public staging is validated as bounded raw byte prefixes of the planned new files before bounded cleanup/recreation.
Terminal `offline` is published only when quarantine and **all** cleanup obligations succeed.
Committed and rolled-back journals replay without writes or lifecycle calls.

migration_ordinal_contract: Every before/after ID requires every actual write chunk, journal generation, staged file and sorted adapter ordinal for that direction. No runtime producer exists; IDs are preparation only.
